clips.title: The story
paras: Ormer's Revenge is an Alliance task given by Ormer Ironbraid at the ruined Whelgar Excavation Site in the Wetlands. With the initial scout raptors culled, Ormer demands the slaughter of the heavier Mottled Scytheclaws and Razormaws that drove his expedition from the pits.

Ormer Ironbraid's grudge against the raptors running rampant over the Whelgar Excavation Site is deeply personal. After thinning out the smaller juveniles that overran the upper camp, he turns your blades against the adult predators prowling the lower dig site. The Mottled Scytheclaws and Razormaws represent the core threat to any hope of reclaiming the archaeological effort, tearing through dwarven prospectors and leaving the trenches littered with shattered crates and abandoned picks.

The excavation pits have effectively turned into a raptor nesting ground. As Ormer broods on the ridge overlooking the dig, he directs capable adventurers down into the mud to strike directly at the mature beasts. While Prospector Whelgar and his crew hope to salvage ancient relics, Ormer is entirely consumed by vengeance, demanding a hefty tally of dead scytheclaws and razormaws before he considers taking on the apex terror of the site.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now it's time to really make those dreaded Raptors regret their blood-thirst. Just down below there are scores of Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws. Make those rotten creatures pay by slaying 10 of each!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I want to make those Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws pay for what they did. Have you killed 10 of each yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You did a bang-up job of clearing out those Raptors, friend!
